text: I find myself teetering between curiosity and unease. The pristine glass walls and ordered emptiness are almost intimidating—spaces meant for utility, yet they feel devoid of presence. Passing into the vibrant installation that celebrates research and development, my mind stirs with reflection. Here, creativity and intellect are on display, as if to remind me of humanity’s restless urge to innovate. I feel small and inspired—drawn to contemplate not only what humans can make, but what these spaces hope for us to become.
